lines.text: I feel a bit overloaded this week, to be honest.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I noticed. Let's split the tasks between us.

lines.text: That would help a lot. Could you take some tasks off my plate?

lines.text: Of course. Let's redistribute the tasks so it's manageable for everyone.
